analysis.summary: Nupur Recyclers Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting a consolidated total revenue of approximately INR 83.03 crore and an EBITDA of INR 12.86 crore. Management highlighted a diversified multi-geography sourcing model for non-ferrous scrap metal imports from the US, Europe, the Middle East, and Australia, shielding operations from regional disruptions. The company is expanding its manufacturing and recycling footprint, notably setting up a 6,000-ton LFP battery recycling plant in Sampla, Haryana, expected to be operational in the next two to three months. Management emphasized an almost debt-free core status and expects structural margin improvements driven by value-added products and operating leverage. Nupur Recyclers Limited presented its annual report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, reporting consolidated total income of ₹ 22,661.35 Lakhs and standalone total income of ₹ 14,259.67 Lakhs.

guidance.claim: Management expects margins to fluctuate within a range and could be around 10% to 25%, without falling back to earlier levels of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: Going forward, margins may fluctuate within a range and could be around 10%–25%. However, we do not expect the margins to fall back to the earlier levels of around 10%–12%.

demand_outlook.claim: Nupur Extrusion operates its Haryana facility catering to solar plant manufacturing and OEM customers, which are seeing strong, secular demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Nupur Extrusion Private Limited operates our Haryana facility and is currently running at 1800 MT per annum capacity against total production capacity of 2400 MT per annum, catering to solar plant manufacturing and OEM (original equipment manufacturer) customers, both segments seeing strong, secular demand in India today.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that India's lithium-ion battery recycling industry is expected to grow rapidly as electric vehicle adoption scales up.
demand_outlook.quote: India's lithium-ion battery recycling industry is still at an early stage, but expected to grow rapidly as electric vehicle adoption scale up.

capex_expansion.claim: Frank Metals plans further capacity expansion in the aluminium extrusion business over the medium term.
capex_expansion.quote: Frank Metals plans further capacity expansion here, with the objective of building a scalable aluminium extrusion business over the medium term.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility in Sampla, Haryana is under construction to produce 200 metric tons per month of zinc and aluminium ingots.
capex_expansion.quote: Our new facility in Sampla, it's coming and it's under construction phase. We will produce zinc ingot, aluminum ingots in it with 200 metric ton per month under construction.

capex_expansion.claim: A new world-class facility for LFP battery recycling with a capacity of 6,000 metric tons per annum is in the construction phase at Sampla.
capex_expansion.quote: New facility at Sampla, NRL. Again, we are coming with a world-class facility of LFP battery and we recycle 6,000 per metric ton per annum. It's, it's in a construction phase.

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved the acquisition of 51,000 equity shares constituting 51% of the paid-up share capital of Tycod Autotech Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on July 25, 2025, approved the acquisition of 51,000 (Fifty-One Thousand) equity shares, constituting 51% of the paid-up share capital of Tycod Autotech Private Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired an additional 1,000 equity shares of Nupur Extrusion Private Limited, increasing its shareholding from 60% to 70%.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, during the financial year 2025-26, on August 12, 2025, the Company acquired an additional 1,000 (One Thousand) equity shares of Nupur Extrusion Private Limited from an existing shareholder, Mr. Ansh Jain.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company acquired an additional 250 equity shares of Nupur Business & Consulting Private Limited from Yogender Singh, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Company acquired an additional 250 equity shares of Nupur Business & Consulting Private Limited (formerly known as Nupur Polymers Private Limited) from an existing shareholder, Mr. Yogender Singh.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of 51,000 equity shares representing a 51% stake in Tycod Autotech Private Limited on September 01, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, after the close of the financial year, the Board, in its meeting held on September 01, 2025, approved the acquisition of 51,000 equity shares, constituting 51% of the shareholding of Tycod Autotech Private Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately INR 83.03 crore compared to INR 53.03 crore in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidate basis, our total revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately INR83.03 crore compared to INR53.03 crore in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 came in at approximately INR 12.86 crore, translating into an EBITDA margin of 15.48%.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA for the quarter came in at approximately INR12.86 crore compared to INR6.08 crore in Q1 FY26 and INR6.83 crore in Q4 FY26, a growth of about 111% year-on-year and about 88% sequentially. This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.48% for the quarter compared to 11.46% in Q1 FY26 and 11.29% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately INR 7.39 crore with a PAT margin of 8.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at approximately INR7.39 crore compared to INR4.04 crore in Q1 FY26 and INR3.35 crore in Q4 FY26, a growth of approximately 82.6% year-on-year and 120.6% subsequently. Over PAT margin for the quarter came in at 8.9% compared to 7.63% a year ago.

orders_capacity.claim: Nupur Recyclers imports approximately 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of scrap metal annually across stainless steel, zinc, and aluminium.
orders_capacity.quote: Every year, we import approximately 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of scrap metal, spread across three metals: around 4,000 tonnes of stainless steel, 3,000 tonnes of zinc, and 2,000 tonnes of aluminium.

orders_capacity.claim: Nupur Extrusion in Sampla has an installed capacity of 2,400 tons per annum and uses 1,800 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we have another facility Nupur Extrusion in Sampla, Haryana. This aluminum extrusion we are producing here. 2,400 tons per annum is its installed capacity and still we are using 1,800 tons per annum. It's running at 75% right now.

orders_capacity.claim: Frank Metals' Palwal facility produces 2,500 metric tons of zinc ingots per annum and 1,200 metric tons of aluminium ingots per annum at 100% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So, if I talk about the Frank Metals Recycling, it is a facility in Palwal, Haryana. So, we are producing zinc ingot 2,500 metric ton per annum. Capacity is the same, 2,500 metric ton per annum is utilized by 100%. Frank Metals Aluminum ingots 1,200 metric ton per annum. Capacity is also same, it's utilized by 100%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company is almost debt-free at its core and intends to fund ongoing expansions largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: We are almost debt-free company at our core and we intend to fund our ongoing expansion plans including the Sampla facility, Frank Metals aluminum extrusion investment and the upcoming LFP plant largely through internal accruals other than relying on external borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26 to conserve profits.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve the profits, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: An amount of ₹ 1,744.93 lakhs was transferred to the Capital Reserve during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, an amount of ₹1,744.93 lakhs was transferred to the Capital Reserve.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 4,30,000 fully paid-up equity shares upon conversion of convertible warrants issued on a preferential basis.
capital_allocation.quote: Accordingly, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on July 02, 2025, approved the allotment of 4,30,000 (Four Lakh Thirty Thousand) fully paid-up equity shares of face value ₹10/- each at an issue price of ₹91/- per equity share (including a premium of ₹81/- per share) upon conversion of an equal number of convertible warrants issued on a preferential basis, after receipt of the balance 75% of the issue price, i.e., ₹68.25/- per warrant, from the respective warrant holders belonging to the Promoter and Non-Promoter categories.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the Financial Year, the Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend.

capital_allocation.claim: The closing balance of retained earnings for FY 2024-2025 after all appropriations and adjustments stood at ₹2,138.84 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The closing balance of the retained earnings of the Company for FY 2024-2025, after all appropriation and adjustments is ₹ 2,138.84 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: Convertible warrants were allotted on September 16, 2024 upon receipt of 25% of the total consideration.
capital_allocation.quote: The said warrants were allotted on September 16, 2024 to such entities on receipt of 25% of the total consideration payable against each such warrant.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the allotment of 4,30,000 equity shares on July 02, 2025 upon conversion of warrants at ₹91 per share upon receiving ₹2,93,47,500.
capital_allocation.quote: Accordingly, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on July 02, 2025, considered and approved the allotment of 4,30,000 (Four Lakh Thirty Thousand) equity shares upon conversion of an equal number of warrants, at an issue price of ₹ 91/- each (including a premium of ₹ 81/- per share), to persons belonging to both Promoter and Non-Promoter categories, on a preferential basis, upon receipt of amount aggregating to ₹ 2,93,47,500 /-

capital_allocation.claim: The Company proposes to provide financial assistance via inter-corporate loan to Tycod Autotech Private Limited to support its daily business operations.
capital_allocation.quote: Further, Tycod Autotech Private Limited may require financial assistance in order to support its day to day business activities and to fulfill its obligation under the proposed aforesaid related party transaction with the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management assured that current geopolitical environments have not had a material impact on operations because scrap is sourced from multiple geographies.
risks_headwinds.quote: I would like to assure you that this has not had a material impact on our operations. The reason is simple: we do not depend on any single country or region for our raw material. We source our scrap metal from multiple geographies the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Australia which gives us the flexibility to reroute our sourcing if any one region faces disruption.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Sampla LFP battery recycling facility is expected to become operational over the next 2 to 3 months.
management_commitments.quote: It is against this backdrop that we are setting up a new facility in Sampla, Haryana with 6,000 tons LFP battery recycling, lithium iron phosphate battery recycling plant. Spread across 5 acres, expected to become operational over next 2 to 3 months.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Nupur Extrusion plant capacity to increase to about 350 tons per month by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We already ordered one more Chinese automatic machine which is 4 inches machine. So, it should be in for the next two or three quarters or maybe this financial year end. We will go by about 350 tons per month.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Sampla plant for zinc and aluminium ingots will be ready for manufacturing in the next two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: So, sir, regarding Sampla plant, already the land is purchased in which construction is in progress. And in the next two to three months it will be ready for manufacturing.

management_commitments.claim: The company did not recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
management_commitments.quote: During the Financial Year, the Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend.

management_commitments.claim: Equity shares against convertible warrants are to be allotted within 18 months from the date of warrant allotment upon receipt of the balance 75% issue price.
management_commitments.quote: Fully paid up Equity Shares of face value Rs. 10/- each of the Company against each such warrant shall be allotted on receipt of balance 75% of the issue price for each such warrant and the same shall be allotted within 18 months from the date of allotment of such warrants.

management_commitments.claim: The shareholders approved the re-appointment of Kapal Kumar Vohra as Independent Director for a second term of five years from August 29, 2025, to August 28, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: approves the re-appointment of Mr. Kapal Kumar Vohra (DIN: 07384162) as an Independent Director (Non-Executive) for a second consecutive term of five years from August 29, 2025, to August 28, 2030.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
